_comment: Bible des creatures. Meme regle que characters.json : le texte est fixe,
et c'est lui qui rend une creature identique entre l'illustration de sa
clairiere et son image de bataille. Palette HGR uniquement.
La BETE DU BASSIN est decrite d'apres l'illustration de couverture.

characters.look: THE POOL BEAST: a bulbous ORANGE-brown swamp creature rising from the water, its body ringed by eight thick tapering tentacles that curl upward; a wide maw of long WHITE fangs dripping slime, two small eyes above it, two short horns, and a single pale WHITE gemstone set in the middle of its forehead.
characters.scale: three times the hero's height, filling half the frame

characters.look: THE WOLVES: lean WHITE-and-BLACK timber wolves, low shoulders, ORANGE eyes, bared fangs.
THE BRIGANDS: ragged men in patched ORANGE-brown leather, hoods and scarves over the face, short curved WHITE blades. Their chief wears a BLUE sash.
THE SPIDERS: BLACK long-legged spiders the size of dogs, glossy abdomens marked with a VIOLET hourglass, clustered ORANGE eyes.
characters.scale: the size of a large dog

characters.look: THE GIANT SCORPION: a VIOLET-black scorpion the size of a man's torso, segmented tail raised and curved forward, heavy pincers held wide, low flat body.
characters.scale: as long as the hero is tall

characters.look: THE GIANT: a huge ORANGE-skinned brute, white hair and beard, BLUE loincloth, swinging a spiked WHITE club; clumsy stance, enormous shoulders.
THE GIANT FROGS: squat GREEN frogs the size of dogs, jaws lined with unexpected WHITE teeth, throats swollen, crouched to leap.
characters.scale: the size of a large dog

characters.look: THE SWAMP ORCS: hunched GREEN-skinned brutes, tusked lower jaws, mismatched ORANGE armour scraps, notched blades.
characters.scale: a head shorter than the hero, broader

characters.look: THE CUTPURSES: wiry men in dark hoods, a short WHITE knife in each hand, cut purses hanging at the belt.
THE UNICORN: a WHITE horse with an ORANGE mane and a single straight spiral horn, wounded flank, lowering its horn to charge.
characters.scale: a tall horse, taller than the hero at the shoulder

characters.look: THE DEMON: a towering VIOLET figure with BLACK bat wings, curved horns, ORANGE burning eyes, clawed hands.
THE BEAR: a heavy ORANGE-brown bear reared on its hind legs, WHITE claws spread, jaws open.
characters.scale: twice the hero's height when reared

characters.look: THE EAGLE: a large bird of prey, WHITE head and ORANGE body, wings spread wide, talons forward.
THE OOZE: a formless GREEN mass of dripping slime, no limbs and no face, spreading across the ground.
THE SWORD-TREES: bare BLACK trunks whose branches end in long WHITE blade-shaped leaves that slash the air.
THE PINCER GRASS: tall GREEN blades of grass ending in snapping jaws, growing thick across the clearing floor.
THE FOUL BEAST: a shapeless ORANGE-brown carcass of a creature, matted hide, too many limbs, a single wide BLACK eye.
THE GOBLIN STATUE: a squat stone goblin come to life, WHITE stone skin cracked at the joints, mouth open in a silent shout.
THE PATROLMAN: a swamp warden in BLUE leathers and a wide hat, spear in hand, suspicious eyes.
THE THIEF: a slight figure in BLACK, face masked to the eyes, a stolen pouch in one hand and a knife in the other.
